visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand displays two plush dachshund keychains, one dressed as a snowman and the other as Santa Claus, against a plain white wall. (2) A man in a grey T-shirt holds a snowman dachshund plush while sitting outdoors next to a colorful dachshund-themed Christmas sign. (3) The scene shifts to the interior of a vibrant shop where customers are browsing; a female staff member in a green Christmas-themed sweater stands behind a counter filled with yellow and red 'A Little Sous of Joy' blind boxes. (4) The man is shown sitting outdoors again, proudly holding several large transparent bags filled with blind box sets, smiling at the camera. (5) Various close-up shots show real dachshund dogs resting on the floor inside the cafe while being petted by customers. (6) The camera focuses on specific merchandise, including a 2026 dachshund-themed calendar, stickers, and graphic T-shirts with Christmas illustrations. (7) Outdoors, the man opens a silver foil bag to reveal a snowman dachshund keychain, looking slightly amused but not completely satisfied. (8) Indoors, sitting on the floor, the man prays over a red blind box before tearing open the foil bag to find a Christmas tree-themed dachshund; he reacts with extreme excitement, covering his mouth in disbelief.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a lifestyle and shopping vlog intended to promote a popular dachshund-themed cafe and its new Christmas blind box merchandise. By combining adorable pet footage with an enthusiastic unboxing experience, the creator aims to entertain fans of 'blind boxes' and the specific dachshund brand while encouraging engagement through a giveaway.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator provides the specific location of the store, shows large quantities of the brand's products, and explicitly mentions the brand name while hosting a giveaway.
